entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I need to start a return. Order number is VF-8675309.
Okay, I can certainly help you with that. Let me just pull up that order. One moment... Okay, I see it here. You're looking to return the Aero-Sprint cycling shoes?
That's right. Just tell me how to send them back.
Of course. I'm sorry they didn't work out. For my notes, could you tell me what the issue was with them?
They're just not right. The positioning for the cleats feels off, and after two rides I'm already getting blisters. I just want a refund.
I understand completely. No problem at all. I see the order was delivered 31 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return window for items like these cycling shoes.

Yes, I've just initiated the return authorization. You'll receive an email with a pre-paid shipping label within the next five minutes. Once we receive the item, your full refund will be processed back to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist with?
